part.text: {"scores":[{"programme":1,"criterion":"fit","value":5,"reason":"Card measures GPU-MD organic-liquid viscosity/conductivity, exactly the EMD step and systems programme currently spot-checks."},{"programme":1,"criterion":"change","value":3,"reason":"Only rising FOM would make it scale MD from spot-check to ranking; plateau confirms ML-first practice, no change."},{"programme":1,"criterion":"new","value":5,"reason":"Practice verifies only eight molecules and uses ML screening; it lacks MD-verified FOM over 100–1000 candidates."},{"programme":2,"criterion":"fit","value":3,"reason":"Outcome concerns GPU-MD ranking, not SDL wet-lab verification; they would bridge computation to 5-sample/hour experimental selection."},{"programme":2,"criterion":"change","value":3,"reason":"Only rising MD FOM justifies adding a GPU pre-filter before SDL; plateau keeps SDL throughput investment unchanged."},{"programme":2,"criterion":"new","value":5,"reason":"SDL verifies candidates experimentally via FOM/CFD, not by GPU-MD scaling, so the MD plateau question lacks evidence."},{"programme":3,"criterion":"fit","value":3,"reason":"Outcome suggests MD verification for esters, but current down-selection depends on predictions plus synthesis; a computational bridge is needed."},{"programme":3,"criterion":"change","value":3,"reason":"Only rising FOM changes their ML-plus-hand-pick pipeline to add MD ranking; plateau confirms current two-candidate practice."},{"programme":3,"criterion":"new","value":5,"reason":"Org-Mol ML-screened millions and validated two experimentally; it never MD-verified hundreds-to-thousands candidates for the scaling question."}]}
